out.description: Output file path, relative to the surface root. export image supports {name}, {frame} (zero-based), {frame1} (one-based), {layer}, {tag}, {tagframe} (zero-based within tag), and {slice}; integer frame fields accept widths such as {frame:02}. Other export subcommands use literal paths.
out.title: Out

overwrite.description: Replace existing output files when true.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

allow_invalid.description: Explicitly export even when validation has errors, recording a warning.
allow_invalid.title: Allow Invalid

frames.description: Frame selection: zero-based index/list, all, range 0-3, or tag:name; omission uses all frames.
frames.title: Frames

layers.description: Layer references to include; omission uses the operation default selection.
layers.title: Layers

color_mode.description: Write palette-indexed or full RGBA output.
color_mode.title: Color Mode

flatten.description: Require exact palette closure (strict) or explicitly map to nearest palette colors.
flatten.title: Flatten

scale.description: Integer nearest-neighbor scale; auto fits previews within their size limit.
scale.title: Scale

crop.description: Integer crop rectangle {x,y,w,h} contained within the canvas.

trim.description: Remove transparent borders and retain original bounds in sheet metadata.
trim.title: Trim

background.description: Background palette index or color; omission preserves transparency.
background.title: Background

apply_pixel_ratio.description: Apply the stored integer display pixel ratio during rendering.
apply_pixel_ratio.title: Apply Pixel Ratio

compression.description: PNG compression: deterministic stored blocks or environment-dependent zlib bytes.
compression.title: Compression
